items.title: At-Bat
items.summary: A plate appearance that ends with a hit, an out or a fielder's choice, excluding walks, hit-by-pitch, sacrifices, catcher's interference and some other events. The denominator of batting average.

structured_payload.definition: A plate appearance that ends with a hit, an out or a fielder's choice, excluding walks, hit-by-pitch, sacrifices, catcher's interference and some other events. The denominator of batting average.

items.title: Plate Appearance
items.summary: Any completed turn at bat, including walks, hit-by-pitch and sacrifices. The broadest measure of batting opportunities.

structured_payload.definition: Any completed turn at bat, including walks, hit-by-pitch and sacrifices. The broadest measure of batting opportunities.

items.title: Hit
items.summary: A base hit: the batter reaches base safely on a fair ball that is not handled by a fielder under the ordinary-effort standard.

structured_payload.definition: A base hit: the batter reaches base safely on a fair ball that is not handled by a fielder under the ordinary-effort standard.

items.title: Single
items.summary: A hit on which the batter reaches first base and no more than one base is credited to the hit.

structured_payload.definition: A hit on which the batter reaches first base and no more than one base is credited to the hit.

items.title: Double
items.summary: A hit on which the batter reaches second base, or advances two bases, because of the hit itself and not a fielder's choice or error.

structured_payload.definition: A hit on which the batter reaches second base, or advances two bases, because of the hit itself and not a fielder's choice or error.

items.title: Triple
items.summary: A hit on which the batter reaches third base.

structured_payload.definition: A hit on which the batter reaches third base.

items.title: Home Run
items.summary: A fair ball that leaves the playing field in flight over the fence, or a hit that allows the batter to circle the bases without an error or fielder's choice.

structured_payload.definition: A fair ball that leaves the playing field in flight over the fence, or a hit that allows the batter to circle the bases without an error or fielder's choice.

items.title: Base on Balls (Walk)
items.summary: An award of first base after four pitches outside the strike zone; an intentional walk may be signalled without pitching.

structured_payload.definition: An award of first base after four pitches outside the strike zone; an intentional walk may be signalled without pitching.

items.title: Intentional Base on Balls
items.summary: A base on balls granted deliberately, now signalled without pitches being thrown.

structured_payload.definition: A base on balls granted deliberately, now signalled without pitches being thrown.

items.title: Hit by Pitch
items.summary: Award of first base when a pitch hits the batter, unless the batter swung, the pitch was in the strike zone, or the batter did not try to avoid it.

structured_payload.definition: Award of first base when a pitch hits the batter, unless the batter swung, the pitch was in the strike zone, or the batter did not try to avoid it.

items.title: Strikeout
items.summary: A time at bat ending in a third strike, whether swinging, looking or on a foul bunt. Also written K.

structured_payload.definition: A time at bat ending in a third strike, whether swinging, looking or on a foul bunt. Also written K.

items.title: Run
items.summary: A score credited to the player who legally touches home plate.

structured_payload.definition: A score credited to the player who legally touches home plate.

items.title: Runs Batted In
items.summary: A run driven in by a base hit, sacrifice, groundout, force out or similar; not credited on a run scored because of an error or in specified double-play cases.

structured_payload.definition: A run driven in by a base hit, sacrifice, groundout, force out or similar; not credited on a run scored because of an error or in specified double-play cases.

items.title: Stolen Base
items.summary: A runner's advance on a pitch without a hit, out, error or other specified cause.

structured_payload.definition: A runner's advance on a pitch without a hit, out, error or other specified cause.

items.title: Caught Stealing
items.summary: A runner put out attempting to steal or advance on a pitch.

structured_payload.definition: A runner put out attempting to steal or advance on a pitch.

items.title: Sacrifice Fly
items.summary: A fly out that scores a runner who tags up; the batter is not charged an at-bat.

structured_payload.definition: A fly out that scores a runner who tags up; the batter is not charged an at-bat.

items.title: Sacrifice Hit (Bunt)
items.summary: A bunt that advances a runner and results in the batter being put out; not charged an at-bat.

structured_payload.definition: A bunt that advances a runner and results in the batter being put out; not charged an at-bat.

items.title: Grounded Into Double Play
items.summary: A batted ball that results in two outs, at least one of which is a force out; used as a context/negative value input.

structured_payload.definition: A batted ball that results in two outs, at least one of which is a force out; used as a context/negative value input.

items.title: Total Bases
items.summary: The sum of bases reached on hits: one per single, two per double, three per triple, four per home run.

structured_payload.definition: The sum of bases reached on hits: one per single, two per double, three per triple, four per home run.

items.title: Batting Average
items.summary: Hits divided by at-bats (H/AB). A traditional rate stat that does not count walks or hit-by-pitch.

structured_payload.definition: Hits divided by at-bats (H/AB). A traditional rate stat that does not count walks or hit-by-pitch.

items.title: On-Base Percentage
items.summary: How often a batter reaches base per plate appearance, including hits, walks and hit-by-pitch: (H+BB+HBP)/(AB+BB+HBP+SF).

structured_payload.definition: How often a batter reaches base per plate appearance, including hits, walks and hit-by-pitch: (H+BB+HBP)/(AB+BB+HBP+SF).

items.title: Slugging Percentage
items.summary: Total bases divided by at-bats (TB/AB); measures power per at-bat.

structured_payload.definition: Total bases divided by at-bats (TB/AB); measures power per at-bat.

items.title: On-Base Plus Slugging
items.summary: OBP + SLG. A simple combined rate stat; it weights OBP and SLG equally, which is not how run value works.

structured_payload.definition: OBP + SLG. A simple combined rate stat; it weights OBP and SLG equally, which is not how run value works.

items.title: OPS+
items.summary: OPS adjusted for ballpark and league, indexed so 100 is league average. A Baseball-Reference-style adjustment; not a FanGraphs metric.

structured_payload.definition: OPS adjusted for ballpark and league, indexed so 100 is league average. A Baseball-Reference-style adjustment; not a FanGraphs metric.

items.title: Batting Average on Balls In Play
items.summary: (H minus HR) divided by (AB minus K minus HR plus SF). Measures outcomes on balls in play; it is influenced by defence, speed and luck and tends to regress toward a pitcher- or league-specific baseline.

structured_payload.definition: (H minus HR) divided by (AB minus K minus HR plus SF). Measures outcomes on balls in play; it is influenced by defence, speed and luck and tends to regress toward a pitcher- or league-specific baseline.

items.title: Isolated Power
items.summary: SLG minus AVG; measures extra-base power per at-bat.

structured_payload.definition: SLG minus AVG; measures extra-base power per at-bat.

items.title: Strikeout Rate (K%)
items.summary: Strikeouts divided by plate appearances. More stable than raw strikeout counts.

structured_payload.definition: Strikeouts divided by plate appearances. More stable than raw strikeout counts.

items.title: Walk Rate (BB%)
items.summary: Walks divided by plate appearances.

structured_payload.definition: Walks divided by plate appearances.

items.title: K-BB%
items.summary: Strikeout rate minus walk rate; a compact measure of a pitcher's or hitter's strike-zone control and dominance.

structured_payload.definition: Strikeout rate minus walk rate; a compact measure of a pitcher's or hitter's strike-zone control and dominance.

items.title: Win
items.summary: Credited to the pitcher who last pitched before his team takes the lead for good, with the starter required to complete five innings in most cases.

structured_payload.definition: Credited to the pitcher who last pitched before his team takes the lead for good, with the starter required to complete five innings in most cases.

items.title: Loss
items.summary: Charged to the pitcher who puts the opposing team ahead for good and whose team does not tie.

structured_payload.definition: Charged to the pitcher who puts the opposing team ahead for good and whose team does not tie.

items.title: Save
items.summary: Credited to a finishing reliever who protects a lead under the rule's criteria, including entering with a lead of no more than three runs and pitching at least one inning, or entering with the tying run on base or at bat.

structured_payload.definition: Credited to a finishing reliever who protects a lead under the rule's criteria, including entering with a lead of no more than three runs and pitching at least one inning, or entering with the tying run on base or at bat.

items.title: Hold
items.summary: An unofficial statistic credited to a reliever who enters in a save situation and records at least one out without surrendering the lead, then leaves without finishing the game.

structured_payload.definition: An unofficial statistic credited to a reliever who enters in a save situation and records at least one out without surrendering the lead, then leaves without finishing the game.

items.title: Blown Save
items.summary: Charged to a reliever who enters in a save situation and allows the tying or go-ahead run to score.

structured_payload.definition: Charged to a reliever who enters in a save situation and allows the tying or go-ahead run to score.

items.title: Earned Run Average
items.summary: Earned runs allowed per nine innings: (ER x 9) / IP. Earned runs exclude runs that score because of an error or passed ball and are reconstructed by the scorer.

structured_payload.definition: Earned runs allowed per nine innings: (ER x 9) / IP. Earned runs exclude runs that score because of an error or passed ball and are reconstructed by the scorer.

items.title: Walks plus Hits per Inning Pitched
items.summary: (BB + H) / IP. Measures baserunners allowed per inning; it does not weight a walk and a home run equally.

structured_payload.definition: (BB + H) / IP. Measures baserunners allowed per inning; it does not weight a walk and a home run equally.

items.title: Innings Pitched
items.summary: Innings recorded by a pitcher, expressed in thirds (for example 6.2 means six and two-thirds innings).

structured_payload.definition: Innings recorded by a pitcher, expressed in thirds (for example 6.2 means six and two-thirds innings).

items.title: ERA+
items.summary: ERA adjusted for ballpark and league, indexed so 100 is league average; a Baseball-Reference-style adjustment.

structured_payload.definition: ERA adjusted for ballpark and league, indexed so 100 is league average; a Baseball-Reference-style adjustment.

items.title: Fielding Independent Pitching
items.summary: A FanGraphs metric expressed on the ERA scale using only strikeouts, walks, hit-by-pitch and home runs, on the premise that balls in play are largely outside the pitcher's control. FIP is provider-specific.

structured_payload.definition: A FanGraphs metric expressed on the ERA scale using only strikeouts, walks, hit-by-pitch and home runs, on the premise that balls in play are largely outside the pitcher's control. FIP is provider-specific.
caveats: does not measure actual runs allowed; it describes peripheral performance

items.title: Expected Fielding Independent Pitching
items.summary: A FanGraphs variant of FIP that replaces the pitcher's actual home-run total with a league-average home-run rate on fly balls, reducing home-run luck.

structured_payload.definition: A FanGraphs variant of FIP that replaces the pitcher's actual home-run total with a league-average home-run rate on fly balls, reducing home-run luck.

items.title: Skill-Interactive ERA
items.summary: A FanGraphs estimator that models the interaction of strikeouts, walks and batted-ball types (ground balls, fly balls, pop-ups) and is scaled to ERA.

structured_payload.definition: A FanGraphs estimator that models the interaction of strikeouts, walks and batted-ball types (ground balls, fly balls, pop-ups) and is scaled to ERA.

items.title: Strikeouts per 9 Innings
items.summary: Strikeouts times nine divided by innings pitched.

structured_payload.definition: Strikeouts times nine divided by innings pitched.

items.title: Walks per 9 Innings
items.summary: Walks times nine divided by innings pitched.

structured_payload.definition: Walks times nine divided by innings pitched.

items.title: Home Runs per 9 Innings
items.summary: Home runs times nine divided by innings pitched.

structured_payload.definition: Home runs times nine divided by innings pitched.

items.title: Left-On-Base Percentage (Strand Rate)
items.summary: The share of baserunners a pitcher leaves on base; it varies with sequencing and tends to regress.

structured_payload.definition: The share of baserunners a pitcher leaves on base; it varies with sequencing and tends to regress.

items.title: Quality Start
items.summary: A start of at least six innings in which the pitcher allows three or fewer earned runs.

structured_payload.definition: A start of at least six innings in which the pitcher allows three or fewer earned runs.

items.title: Complete Game
items.summary: A start in which the pitcher pitches the entire game for his team.

structured_payload.definition: A start in which the pitcher pitches the entire game for his team.

items.title: Shutout
items.summary: A complete game in which the pitcher allows no runs.

structured_payload.definition: A complete game in which the pitcher allows no runs.

items.title: Games Started
items.summary: The number of games a pitcher started.

structured_payload.definition: The number of games a pitcher started.

items.title: Putout
items.summary: Credited to the fielder who catches a fly ball or tags or forces a runner.

structured_payload.definition: Credited to the fielder who catches a fly ball or tags or forces a runner.

items.title: Assist
items.summary: Credited to a fielder whose throw or deflection leads to a putout.

structured_payload.definition: Credited to a fielder whose throw or deflection leads to a putout.

items.title: Error
items.summary: Charged when a fielder misplays a ball an ordinary-effort fielder would have handled, allowing a runner to advance.

structured_payload.definition: Charged when a fielder misplays a ball an ordinary-effort fielder would have handled, allowing a runner to advance.

items.title: Double Play
items.summary: Two offensive players put out by continuous action without an error between putouts.

structured_payload.definition: Two offensive players put out by continuous action without an error between putouts.

items.title: Fielding Percentage
items.summary: (Putouts + Assists) / (Putouts + Assists + Errors). A traditional but limited measure because it ignores range.

structured_payload.definition: (Putouts + Assists) / (Putouts + Assists + Errors). A traditional but limited measure because it ignores range.

items.title: Passed Ball
items.summary: A pitch the catcher should have handled, charged to the catcher; runners may advance.

structured_payload.definition: A pitch the catcher should have handled, charged to the catcher; runners may advance.

items.title: Stolen Bases Allowed (Catcher)
items.summary: Stolen bases charged against a catcher; used with caught-stealing rate to evaluate catcher defence.

structured_payload.definition: Stolen bases charged against a catcher; used with caught-stealing rate to evaluate catcher defence.

items.title: Ultimate Zone Rating
items.summary: A FanGraphs defensive metric estimating runs saved or lost relative to an average fielder, combining range, arm, double-play and error components. It requires multi-season samples to be stable.

structured_payload.definition: A FanGraphs defensive metric estimating runs saved or lost relative to an average fielder, combining range, arm, double-play and error components. It requires multi-season samples to be stable.

items.title: Defensive Runs Saved
items.summary: A Sports Info Solutions metric, published on FanGraphs and elsewhere, estimating runs saved relative to average by a fielder. Provider-specific and noisy in small samples.

structured_payload.definition: A Sports Info Solutions metric, published on FanGraphs and elsewhere, estimating runs saved relative to average by a fielder. Provider-specific and noisy in small samples.

items.title: Total Zone
items.summary: A Baseball-Reference defensive metric based on play-by-play and batted-ball data, expressed in runs above or below average.

structured_payload.definition: A Baseball-Reference defensive metric based on play-by-play and batted-ball data, expressed in runs above or below average.

items.title: Catcher Framing
items.summary: Runs saved by a catcher by presenting borderline pitches as strikes, estimated from called-strike probability models. Provider definitions differ.

structured_payload.definition: Runs saved by a catcher by presenting borderline pitches as strikes, estimated from called-strike probability models. Provider definitions differ.

items.title: wOBA
items.summary: Weighted On-Base Average: a rate stat that weights each offensive event (walk, single, extra-base hit) by its run value and scales to OBP. League-average wOBA changes by season.

structured_payload.definition: Weighted On-Base Average: a rate stat that weights each offensive event (walk, single, extra-base hit) by its run value and scales to OBP. League-average wOBA changes by season.

items.title: wRC+
items.summary: Weighted Runs Created Plus: offensive value in runs, park- and league-adjusted and indexed so 100 is league average. A 125 wRC+ means 25% more runs created than a league-average hitter would have produced in the same plate appearances.

structured_payload.definition: Weighted Runs Created Plus: offensive value in runs, park- and league-adjusted and indexed so 100 is league average. A 125 wRC+ means 25% more runs created than a league-average hitter would have produced in the same plate appearances.

items.title: wRAA
items.summary: Weighted Runs Above Average: the batting component of wOBA expressed in runs above league average, before park adjustment.

structured_payload.definition: Weighted Runs Above Average: the batting component of wOBA expressed in runs above league average, before park adjustment.

items.title: WAR (Wins Above Replacement)
items.summary: A family of estimates of a player's total value in wins over a replacement-level player. There is no single WAR: FanGraphs (fWAR), Baseball-Reference (bWAR) and Baseball Prospectus (WARP) use different defensive, pitching and baserunning inputs and can differ by more than a win. Always name the provider.

structured_payload.definition: A family of estimates of a player's total value in wins over a replacement-level player. There is no single WAR: FanGraphs (fWAR), Baseball-Reference (bWAR) and Baseball Prospectus (WARP) use different defensive, pitching and baserunning inputs and can differ by more than a win. Always name the provider.
caveats: provider-specific; never mix with the same-named metric from another provider

items.title: fWAR
items.summary: FanGraphs WAR: uses FanGraphs offensive (wRC+), baserunning and fielding (UZR/DRS blend) inputs and FIP-based pitching runs. Not interchangeable with bWAR.

structured_payload.definition: FanGraphs WAR: uses FanGraphs offensive (wRC+), baserunning and fielding (UZR/DRS blend) inputs and FIP-based pitching runs. Not interchangeable with bWAR.
caveats: provider-specific; never mix with the same-named metric from another provider

items.title: bWAR
items.summary: Baseball-Reference WAR: uses Baseball-Reference batting runs, DRS/Total Zone defence and a runs-allowed-based pitching model (RA9). Not interchangeable with fWAR.

structured_payload.definition: Baseball-Reference WAR: uses Baseball-Reference batting runs, DRS/Total Zone defence and a runs-allowed-based pitching model (RA9). Not interchangeable with fWAR.
caveats: provider-specific; never mix with the same-named metric from another provider

items.title: WARP
items.summary: Wins Above Replacement Player, the Baseball Prospectus value metric. Its inputs and replacement level differ from fWAR and bWAR.

structured_payload.definition: Wins Above Replacement Player, the Baseball Prospectus value metric. Its inputs and replacement level differ from fWAR and bWAR.
caveats: provider-specific; never mix with the same-named metric from another provider

items.title: RE24
items.summary: The change in run expectancy across the 24 base-out states, summed over a player's events. It measures context-dependent run contribution.

structured_payload.definition: The change in run expectancy across the 24 base-out states, summed over a player's events. It measures context-dependent run contribution.

items.title: Win Probability Added
items.summary: The change in win probability from each event, summed over a player's plate appearances or pitches. It is descriptive and context-dependent, not predictive.

structured_payload.definition: The change in win probability from each event, summed over a player's plate appearances or pitches. It is descriptive and context-dependent, not predictive.

items.title: Leverage Index
items.summary: A measure of the pressure of the game state when an event occurs, where 1.0 is average leverage. Used to weight WPA and to evaluate reliever usage.

structured_payload.definition: A measure of the pressure of the game state when an event occurs, where 1.0 is average leverage. Used to weight WPA and to evaluate reliever usage.

items.title: Clutch
items.summary: A FanGraphs metric measuring how much better or worse a player performs in high-leverage situations relative to his overall performance; it is unstable and should not be over-interpreted.

structured_payload.definition: A FanGraphs metric measuring how much better or worse a player performs in high-leverage situations relative to his overall performance; it is unstable and should not be over-interpreted.

items.title: Base Running Runs (BsR)
items.summary: FanGraphs' aggregate baserunning metric, combining stolen-base runs (wSB), ultimate baserunning (UBR) and other components.

structured_payload.definition: FanGraphs' aggregate baserunning metric, combining stolen-base runs (wSB), ultimate baserunning (UBR) and other components.

items.title: Ultimate Base Running
items.summary: The non-stolen-base component of FanGraphs baserunning: advancing on hits, outs, wild pitches and errors, and avoiding outs on the bases.

structured_payload.definition: The non-stolen-base component of FanGraphs baserunning: advancing on hits, outs, wild pitches and errors, and avoiding outs on the bases.

items.title: Weighted Stolen Base Runs
items.summary: The stolen-base component of FanGraphs baserunning, weighting steals and caught-stealings by run value.

structured_payload.definition: The stolen-base component of FanGraphs baserunning, weighting steals and caught-stealings by run value.

items.title: Weighted Grounded Into Double Play Runs
items.summary: The double-play component of FanGraphs baserunning, crediting fast runners and penalising double-play-prone hitters.

structured_payload.definition: The double-play component of FanGraphs baserunning, crediting fast runners and penalising double-play-prone hitters.

items.title: Speed Score (Spd)
items.summary: A FanGraphs composite of stolen-base attempts, success rate, triples and grounded-into-double-play rate.

structured_payload.definition: A FanGraphs composite of stolen-base attempts, success rate, triples and grounded-into-double-play rate.

items.title: HR/FB
items.summary: Home runs divided by fly balls. Pitchers and hitters tend to regress toward their own baselines; a large deviation is often not sustainable.

structured_payload.definition: Home runs divided by fly balls. Pitchers and hitters tend to regress toward their own baselines; a large deviation is often not sustainable.

items.title: Ground-Ball Rate (GB%)
items.summary: Ground balls divided by balls in play. A high ground-ball rate reduces home-run risk.

structured_payload.definition: Ground balls divided by balls in play. A high ground-ball rate reduces home-run risk.

items.title: Fly-Ball Rate (FB%)
items.summary: Fly balls divided by balls in play, excluding line drives and pop-ups by provider convention.

structured_payload.definition: Fly balls divided by balls in play, excluding line drives and pop-ups by provider convention.

items.title: Line-Drive Rate (LD%)
items.summary: Line drives divided by balls in play; classification depends on the tracking/scoring provider.

structured_payload.definition: Line drives divided by balls in play; classification depends on the tracking/scoring provider.

items.title: Hard-Hit Rate
items.summary: The share of batted balls with an exit velocity at or above Statcast's hard-hit threshold (typically 95 mph).

structured_payload.definition: The share of batted balls with an exit velocity at or above Statcast's hard-hit threshold (typically 95 mph).

items.title: Exit Velocity
items.summary: The speed of the ball off the bat, measured in mph by Statcast. Hard-hit is typically 95+ mph; average exit velocity is descriptive and should be paired with launch angle.

structured_payload.definition: The speed of the ball off the bat, measured in mph by Statcast. Hard-hit is typically 95+ mph; average exit velocity is descriptive and should be paired with launch angle.

items.title: Launch Angle
items.summary: The vertical angle of the batted ball off the bat, in degrees. Optimal damage combines high exit velocity with a launch angle in the 10-30 degree range.

structured_payload.definition: The vertical angle of the batted ball off the bat, in degrees. Optimal damage combines high exit velocity with a launch angle in the 10-30 degree range.

items.title: Barrel
items.summary: A batted ball with an exit velocity and launch angle combination that historically produces at least a .500 batting average and 1.500 slugging percentage. The exact thresholds vary by exit velocity.

structured_payload.definition: A batted ball with an exit velocity and launch angle combination that historically produces at least a .500 batting average and 1.500 slugging percentage. The exact thresholds vary by exit velocity.

items.title: Hard-Hit
items.summary: A batted ball with an exit velocity of 95 mph or higher.

structured_payload.definition: A batted ball with an exit velocity of 95 mph or higher.

items.title: Sweet Spot
items.summary: A batted ball with a launch angle between 8 and 32 degrees, the range that produces the most damage.

structured_payload.definition: A batted ball with a launch angle between 8 and 32 degrees, the range that produces the most damage.

items.title: Expected Batting Average (xBA)
items.summary: A Statcast estimate of what a batter's average would be given the exit velocity and launch angle of each batted ball, removing defence and positioning.

structured_payload.definition: A Statcast estimate of what a batter's average would be given the exit velocity and launch angle of each batted ball, removing defence and positioning.

items.title: Expected Slugging (xSLG)
items.summary: The expected slugging percentage from the same batted-ball quality inputs as xBA.

structured_payload.definition: The expected slugging percentage from the same batted-ball quality inputs as xBA.

items.title: Expected wOBA (xwOBA)
items.summary: Expected wOBA from batted-ball quality plus strikeouts, walks and hit-by-pitch; it removes defence and batted-ball luck.

structured_payload.definition: Expected wOBA from batted-ball quality plus strikeouts, walks and hit-by-pitch; it removes defence and batted-ball luck.

items.title: Expected ERA (xERA)
items.summary: A Statcast ERA estimator based on expected wOBA allowed, scaled to ERA.

structured_payload.definition: A Statcast ERA estimator based on expected wOBA allowed, scaled to ERA.

items.title: Bat Speed
items.summary: The speed of the bat at the sweet spot, measured in mph. Statcast made bat-tracking metrics publicly available in the 2020s.

structured_payload.definition: The speed of the bat at the sweet spot, measured in mph. Statcast made bat-tracking metrics publicly available in the 2020s.

items.title: Swing Length
items.summary: The distance the bat travels from the start of the swing to contact, in feet. Shorter swings generally allow later decisions.

structured_payload.definition: The distance the bat travels from the start of the swing to contact, in feet. Shorter swings generally allow later decisions.

items.title: Sprint Speed
items.summary: Statcast's measure of a runner's top speed, in feet per second, on the fastest one-third of competitive runs.

structured_payload.definition: Statcast's measure of a runner's top speed, in feet per second, on the fastest one-third of competitive runs.

items.title: Arm Strength
items.summary: The maximum throw speed recorded for a fielder, in mph.

structured_payload.definition: The maximum throw speed recorded for a fielder, in mph.

items.title: Pop Time
items.summary: The time from the catcher's receipt of the pitch to the fielder's receipt of the throw at the base, in seconds; the key catcher throwing metric.

structured_payload.definition: The time from the catcher's receipt of the pitch to the fielder's receipt of the throw at the base, in seconds; the key catcher throwing metric.

items.title: Catch Probability
items.summary: Statcast's estimate of the probability that an average fielder would catch a given batted ball, based on distance, hang time and direction. Five-star catches are the hardest.

structured_payload.definition: Statcast's estimate of the probability that an average fielder would catch a given batted ball, based on distance, hang time and direction. Five-star catches are the hardest.

items.title: Outs Above Average
items.summary: A Statcast range metric: the difference between outs recorded and expected outs (from catch probability) for a fielder.

structured_payload.definition: A Statcast range metric: the difference between outs recorded and expected outs (from catch probability) for a fielder.

items.title: Pitch Velocity
items.summary: The speed of a pitch out of the hand, typically reported at release (and, when noted, at the plate).

structured_payload.definition: The speed of a pitch out of the hand, typically reported at release (and, when noted, at the plate).

items.title: Spin Rate
items.summary: The rate of rotation of a pitch, in revolutions per minute, measured by the tracking system.

structured_payload.definition: The rate of rotation of a pitch, in revolutions per minute, measured by the tracking system.

items.title: Spin Axis
items.summary: The direction of the pitch's spin axis in degrees; combined with spin rate, it describes the movement profile.

structured_payload.definition: The direction of the pitch's spin axis in degrees; combined with spin rate, it describes the movement profile.

items.title: Active Spin / Spin Efficiency
items.summary: The share of total spin that contributes to the pitch's movement (as opposed to gyro spin), expressed as a percentage.

structured_payload.definition: The share of total spin that contributes to the pitch's movement (as opposed to gyro spin), expressed as a percentage.

items.title: Extension
items.summary: The distance from the pitcher's release point to the front edge of the rubber, in feet; more extension effectively shortens the pitch's travel time.

structured_payload.definition: The distance from the pitcher's release point to the front edge of the rubber, in feet; more extension effectively shortens the pitch's travel time.

items.title: Release Point
items.summary: The horizontal and vertical position of the pitch at release, in feet.

structured_payload.definition: The horizontal and vertical position of the pitch at release, in feet.

items.title: Induced Vertical Break
items.summary: The vertical movement of a pitch attributable to its spin, measured relative to a spinless trajectory (in inches).

structured_payload.definition: The vertical movement of a pitch attributable to its spin, measured relative to a spinless trajectory (in inches).

items.title: Horizontal Break
